title: Adjunction normal form for the source side of integral exchange
statement: Under exactly the prime, normed coefficient, characteristic, finite-type separated scheme and commutative square hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-exchange-equality], the inverse bounded f′ adjunction hom-equivalence sends the source side of the exchange identity to the explicit composite f′_E(α_g(Rf_I K)) ≫ θ_E(T_Y Rf_I K) ≫ g′_E(α_f(Rf_I K) inverse) ≫ g′_E(T_X ε_f(K)). This is a calculation of only one side; it does not assert equality of the source and target sides.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, compatibility with adjunctions and base change

proof.text: Use the generic source_normal_form calculation: apply inverse-adjunction naturality to the source comparison, substitute the exchange adjunct, move the coefficient push comparison through the square isomorphism by naturality, and substitute the coefficient/counit identity. The latter follows from iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_symm and mateEquiv_counit_symm. To pass to bounded constructible objects, use the fully faithful inclusion, map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app and the identity compatibility isomorphisms. All these auxiliary calculations are proved in Lean. The exchange adjunct is exposed by squareExchange, which is proved equal to the original unit-square-counit transformation.

theorem integralConstructible_exchange_source_adjunct
    (sq : CommSq g' f' f g) (K : integralConstructible ℓ E X) :
    ((boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (f'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (integralConstructibleSourceHom ℓ E k f g K ≫
        (boundedConstructibleBaseChange (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (sq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).app
          ((integralScalarConstructible ℓ E X).obj K)) =
    (boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (f'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).map
        (integralConstructiblePullHom ℓ E k g
          ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj K)) ≫
      (boundedConstructiblePullbackSquareComparison (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (sq.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).hom.app
          ((integralScalarConstructible ℓ E Y).obj
            ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj K)) ≫
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (g'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).map
        (integralConstructiblePullIso ℓ E k f
          ((boundedConstructibleLowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).obj K)).inv ≫
      (boundedConstructibleUpperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) ℓ (g'.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).map
        ((integralScalarConstructible ℓ E X).map
          ((boundedConstructibleUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (integralCoeff ℓ E) ℓ (f.asOver (Spec (.of k)))).counit.app K))
